The '''Huulia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the planet [[Huulia/Legends|Huulia]], the homeworld of [[Kit Valent/Legends|Kit Valent]], and the Huulian [[starfighter]]s.
